title: Chapter 437 - 437 Replying; Magical Prosthetic Legs!
content:
Chapter 437 - 437 Replying; Magical Prosthetic Legs!

Chapter 437 - 437 Replying; Magical Prosthetic Legs!

437 Replying; Magical Prosthetic Legs!

Hu Tian could not help but walk forward and say, “Lin Fan, is what you said true?”

Lin Fan smiled. “When have I ever lied to you? Don’t worry!”

As he spoke, he gently patted the back of Hu Tian’s hand.

Then, he carried the big box to the bed.

Under everyone’s gaze, Lin Fan took out prosthetic legs from the big box.

Lin Fan introduced, “These are prosthetics. After they’re installed, they can perfectly replace the original legs.

“Second Brother Hu, your whole body might be a little numb later.”

“Alright.” Hu Shaodong nodded.

Lin Fan lifted Hu Shaodong’s lower body.

Even though Hu Shaodong’s injuries had all healed, one could still see the hideous wounds on his legs.

Many people from the Hu family felt their hearts tremble. They felt extremely sad.

Lin Fan took out the prosthetic legs and compared them to the thighs.

Then, he connected one end of the prosthetic legs to Hu Shaodong’s broken ones.

Just as Lin Fan said, Hu Shaodong’s whole body felt numb.

At this moment, Hu Shaodong seemed to have lost consciousness. Even his brain stopped thinking.

In the eyes of the Hu family…

The liquid on the prosthetic leg suddenly squirmed violently and seeped into Hu Shaodong’s broken legs.

It was very strange.

About three minutes later, the liquid disappeared.

The prosthetic legs were perfectly connected to Hu Shaodong’s body.

It was as if…

It was as if these were Hu Shaodong’s legs and not artificial limbs.

At this moment, the numbness in Hu Shaodong’s body gradually disappeared.

“Are you done?” he asked after a pause.

Lin Fan nodded. “Alright, Second Brother Hu. Try standing up.”

“Alright,” Hu Shaodong replied.

The next moment, he was completely stunned.

He really stood up.

He could walk forward, walk back, and even spin!

He was extremely agile and free!

It was as if his legs had grown back!

He jumped excitedly.

He jumped two meters high!

His head hit the roof.

Then, he landed steadily on the ground.

This scene not only shocked Hu Shaodong but also everyone in the Hu family!

It was as though his legs had grown back!

He had a pair of super legs!

Hu Shaodong widened his eyes and looked down at his legs. His face was filled with disbelief.

In fact, he did not have much hope for the prosthetic limbs at first.

After all, they were just prosthetics.

However, what was the situation now?

Even though Hu Shaodong had experienced many things, at this moment, he could not help but stutter, “Lin… Lin Fan…My… These are…”

Lin Fan said, “This are prosthetics. Are they useful?”

Hu Shaodong nodded vigorously and said, “But why do I feel like they’re really my legs? No! They’re even better than my own legs! Especially in terms of strength and speed!”

As he spoke, he kicked his legs and ran quickly.

Lin Fan explained, “This is normal. This is because the artificial limbs are already connected to your nerves and tendons. Of course, you can control them like your own legs.

“As for the strength and speed, it’s because of the materials.”

“That’s great! Shaodong has legs again!” cried his aunt happily.

After a pause, the aunt continued, “This… Would his legs break? How should he take care of them? Are they made from metal? Will they be harmful to the body?”

She was not doubting Lin Fan.

It was out of concern for her family member.

After all, she did not know about artificial limbs.

Lin Fan was not angry and explained, “Don’t worry, the materials used for these prosthetic limbs are far beyond medical grade. They won’t cause any harm to the body. As for the damage to the prosthetic limbs, they’ll be damaged if they’re blown up by artillery shells.

“But the prosthetics are very stable. They’re water and fire-resistant. There’s no need to take special care of them.”

When everyone heard Lin Fan’s words, the admiration on their faces intensified.

The prosthetics could be considered a pair of transplanted legs. They were stronger and more perfect!

Hu Hu Nanshan shouted, “Shaodong, what are you doing? Hurry up and thank Lin Fan!”

The prosthetics were definitely a mystical item that could be compared to Medical Water!

Hu Nanshan knew that Lin Fan must have paid a huge price for it!

Hu Shaodong also understood this and said solemnly, “Lin Fan, thank you!”

“It’s just a small matter.” Lin Fan smiled. “Besides, you’re Tiantian’s second brother. So, there’s no need to thank me.”

In order to thank Lin Fan for saving Hu Shaodong and giving him the prosthetics, the Hu family specially organized a grand banquet.

Without a doubt, Lin Fan was the main character of this meal.

Everyone in the Hu family, including Old Master Hu Nanshan, kept toasting Lin Fan.

Everyone ate and drank happily.

…

The night gradually darkened.

Hu Tian and Lin Fan walked side by side on the small hill behind the courtyard.

“Lin Fan, thank goodness I have you.” Hu Tian sighed sincerely.

As she spoke, she could not help but think of the scene of Lin Fan solving a math problem seriously.

She thought of the scene of Lin Fan writing calligraphy elegantly.

She thought of the scene when Lin Fan came to congratulate her grandfather on his birthday.

Finally, she thought of the scene of Lin Fan coming to her house.

Hu Tian’s face turned red, and her entire body went limp. She could not help but lean toward Lin Fan.

…

Lin Fan and Hu Tian only walked down the hill when it was very late. Their faces were slightly red.

After being blown by the cool breeze for a while, their faces gradually returned to normal.

At this moment…

Hu Tian seemed to have thought of something and asked, “Lin Fan, what were you doing at the toy factory today?”

In fact, she had been curious about this for a long time.

However, there were too many people in the Hu family’s compound earlier.

She was worried that Lin Fan would be put in a difficult position, so she did not ask.

Lin Fan said, “I did some research and developed the prosthetics.”

Research?

Moreover, he did research in a toy factory?!

He only studied it for an afternoon…

Yet he had developed prosthetics with such miraculous effects!

This…

This…

Hu Tian knew that Lin Fan had solved several world-class mathematics problems and invented the earthquake prediction device, the human islet recovery drug, the super battery, the carbon-based photolithographic machine, and many other things. He was called a super genius by many people.

However, when Hu Tian heard Lin Fan’s answer, she was still shocked.

She looked at Lin Fan, and her beautiful eyes flashed.

After a gust of wind blew past, Hu Tian’s pretty face, which had finally returned to normal, turned red again. She approached Lin Fan again.

Then, she pulled Lin Fan back to the small hill.
